inputPlaceholder: Describe the project experience to write, or use a quick action above…
quickDraftAllPrompt: Fully digest each repo’s README, stack, and all commit/change evidence first, then output a paste-ready Markdown project resume (title/blurb/stack/2–5 approach bullets). Ban “N commits, tell me which direction” stubs; no logic code or field magic numbers; no basics; skip trivial work; do not invent.
quickListProjectsPrompt: Digest evidence first, then per repo directly list: recognizable name, one-line purpose, stack, 2–5 approach bullets. No commit-count stubs or asking the user to choose a focus; no logic code; no process talk.
quickRewriteEvidencePrompt: Rewrite into paste-ready high-signal bullets (challenge → approach → value) from existing evidence. Remove commit-count reports, questions back to the user, logic code, and fluff. Never ask the user to pick a direction.
openFailed: Could not open Resume Helper window
